theorems.name: Submission.fiw_ims_sc_continuous_of_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (L : TestFormOn U n → ℝ), (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ A : ℝ, ∀ (ω : TestFormOn U n) (C : ℝ), 0 < C → tsupport ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n)) ⊆ K → (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) x) ≤ C) → |L ω| ≤ A * C) → ∀ ωs : ℕ → TestFormOn U n, TestFormOnConverges ωs 0 → Tendsto (fun q => L (ωs q)) atTop (𝓝 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
